scope.case: real-data WRF UDM27, RRTMGP37/37, frozen-optics mode 1, MPI4, completed 24-hour run
scope.history_sampling: 25 hourly snapshots, 2010-06-11_00:00:00 through 2010-06-12_00:00:00; not every timestep or radiation call
scope.interpretation: history grid mixing ratios and reconstructed layer paths only; not exact microphysics process PSD/slope/radius and not accuracy validation
scope.native_dry_mass_formula: -DNW*(C1H*(MU+MUB)+C2H)/9.81 kg m-2; q times dry mass and 1000 gives g m-2. AREA2D used for area-weighted domain total kg
scope.negative_values: counted and retained in signed path; no clipping/correction
scope.warm_criterion: Tactual=(T+300)*(Ptotal/100000)^(287/1004.5), Ptotal=P+PB; diagnostic only, QGRAUP/QHAIL can be warm without implying a port error
